name: Atlantic Union Bankshares Corporation
tagline: Regional bank providing comprehensive financial services across the Mid-Atlantic region
hero_kpi_rationale: Le revenu net d'intérêts (FTE) est le principal moteur de revenus pour une banque régionale, reflétant la marge nette d'intérêts et la qualité du portefeuille de prêts ajusté pour les différences de traitement fiscal

kpis.explanation: Net interest income adjusted for tax-equivalent basis (FTE adjustment reflects tax treatment differences on tax-exempt income sources)
kpis.signal: Net interest income increased significantly year-over-year
kpis.description: Net interest income adjusted for differences in tax treatment of interest income sources

kpis.explanation: Common equity adjusted for goodwill and amortizable intangibles, excluding perpetual preferred stock
kpis.signal: Tangible common equity increased significantly year-over-year
kpis.description: Common equity adjusted for goodwill and intangible assets

kpis.name_en: Tangible Common Equity to Tangible Assets Ratio
kpis.explanation: Tangible common equity as a percentage of tangible assets, a key capital adequacy metric
kpis.description: Ratio of tangible common equity to tangible assets

kpis.explanation: Net interest income on a tax-equivalent basis divided by average earning assets, a key profitability metric
kpis.description: Net interest margin on a tax-equivalent basis

stories_kpis.name_fr: Impact de l'acquisition de Sandy Spring
stories_kpis.explanation: Completed acquisition of Sandy Spring Bancorp on April 1, 2025, adding over 50 branches in Virginia, Maryland, and Washington D.C.
stories_kpis.signal: Total assets increased significantly through acquisition and organic growth
stories_kpis.description: Total assets reached $37.6 billion at year-end 2025 following Sandy Spring integration

stories_kpis.name_fr: Gain sur vente de prêts immobiliers commerciaux
stories_kpis.explanation: Sale of performing CRE loans from Sandy Spring acquisition on June 26, 2025 with $2.0 billion unpaid principal balance
stories_kpis.signal: Strategic portfolio optimization generated pre-tax gain
stories_kpis.description: Pre-tax gain of $10.9 million from CRE loan sale, net of transaction expenses

ai_positioning.summary: The company does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K filing

risks.title: Insufficiency of Allowance for Credit Losses
risks.score_rationale: This risk is highlighted as the primary credit risk factor with strong language regarding estimation uncertainty and impact on results. It is central to the 10-K risk disclosures and reinforced by changing economic conditions. Credit risk is a highly weighted category in the financial sector. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Estimation of credit losses may prove inaccurate, potentially resulting in insufficient reserves and unexpected losses on the loan portfolio.

risks.title: Exposure to Local Real Estate Market Risk
risks.score_rationale: Text emphasizes geographic concentration of real estate loans and vulnerability to local market shocks. The risk is repeated and directly linked to portfolio quality and collateral values. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Deterioration in local real estate markets could reduce collateral values and increase loan losses.

risks.title: Commercial Real Estate Loan Risk
risks.score_rationale: Commercial real estate loans are identified as higher risk with significant balances and tenant cash flow dependencies. Text mentions heightened regulatory scrutiny, increasing the severity rating. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Commercial real estate loans are sensitive to occupancy rates and economic conditions, with elevated default risk.

risks.title: Construction and Development Loan Risk
risks.score_rationale: Risk stems from uncertainty in construction costs and future value assessments. Text emphasizes that collateral may be insufficient in case of price declines, signaling elevated concern. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Construction loans are exposed to cost overruns and valuation errors, increasing loss potential.

risks.title: Dependence on Federal Guarantee Programs
risks.score_rationale: Risk relates to regulatory compliance and potential loss of guarantee coverage. While program-specific, it is noted as potentially material, with non-negligible exposure. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Non-compliance with federal program rules could result in credit losses or program exclusion.

risks.title: Real Estate Valuation Inaccuracy
risks.score_rationale: Appraisal errors are cited as potentially distorting collateral values and impacting financial statements. Risk is recurring and linked to market volatility, especially during uncertain periods. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Inaccurate real estate appraisals could lead to underestimated losses or undetected non-performing assets.

risks.title: Small and Medium Enterprise Credit Risk
risks.score_rationale: Text highlights SME vulnerability to economic cycles and limited financial resources. Risk is heightened by fact that some borrowers lack crisis experience, increasing uncertainty. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: SME borrowers have lower economic resilience, increasing default risk during economic downturns.

governance.voting_structure: Shareholders elect directors annually for one-year terms
